data.title: Air India A320 from Phuket to New Delhi issued stall warning when seatbelt signs off, injuring 24, investigators say
data.description: BENGALURU - An Air India A320 flying from Phuket to New Delhi last month issued a stall warning when seatbelt signs were off, while a rapid pitch up and then down threw passengers and cabin crew against overhead bins and injured 24 people, Indian investigators said.

data.title: China arrests 52 Singaporeans for alleged pyramid scheme activities
data.description: SINGAPORE — Chinese ⁠authorities ⁠haves arrested 52 Singaporeans ​in Guangxi, China, after a law enforcement operation ​against pyramid scheme activities ‌and related offences, Singapore's second minister for foreign affairs said on Friday.

data.title: Singaporean fleeing drug charges at home arrested at Bangkok condo
data.description: A 40-year-old Singaporean man wanted in his home country on drug charges has been arrested in Bangkok’s Bang Khae district after hiding in Thailand for almost three years.

data.title: Japanese scientist posthumously wins Ig Nobel prize for nose-blowing study
data.description: The late Japanese researcher Tokuji Unno won this year's Ig Nobel Prize in medicine on Thursday for his study on how to blow one's nose.

data.title: Tanker captain arrested over cargo ship sinking off Istanbul
data.description: ISTANBUL - The captain of an oil tanker that collided with a cargo ship which sank off Istanbul leaving 10 missing has been arrested along with his third-in-command on charges of negligent homicide, prosecutors in Turkey said Friday.

data.title: South Korean scam gang leader arrested in Nonthaburi
data.description: PHUKET — A leading member of a South Korean gambling scam gang accused of causing more than 250 million baht in damage in his country has been arrested and will be sent back after facing a charge in Thailand.

data.title: Lisa’s new single goes viral on release day
data.description: Lisa’s new song, SaWaDika , has drawn more than 8 million viewers on the first day of its release.

data.title: Night-owl Zverev goes distance to advance as upsets rock US Open
data.description: NEW YORK - Top-seeded Alexander Zverev kept his bid for a first US Open title on track with a gritty five-set victory over Quentin Halys, staying the course as a spate of upsets rocked the men's draw on Thursday.

data.title: UK asserts 'unshakeable' Falklands commitment after Milei presses claim
data.description: BUENOS AIRES (ARGENTINA) - Britain insisted on Friday that the Falkland Islands "are British" after Argentine President Javier Milei said the "winds of change" favored his country's claim to the archipelago, citing Washington's readiness to review its neutrality in the dispute.

data.title: German AfD's love for Simson mopeds dismays Jewish family behind brand
data.description: BERLIN - German far-right AfD politicians have shown a fondness for riding vintage Simson scooters that are icons of the former communist East Germany -- much to the dismay of the Jewish family whose name adorns the machines.

data.title: Bank of Thailand plans mandatory BNPL licences under new rules
data.description: The Bank of Thailand plans a September hearing on mandatory BNPL licences, with new rules targeted for the fourth quarter and broader non-bank oversight.

data.description: Lisa’s new “SaWaDiKa” music video takes fans across four distinctive Bangkok locations, blending Thai culture, street life and contemporary design.

data.title: Arsenal brace for Chelsea test as Spurs seek spark
data.description: LONDON — Something has to give when Arsenal host Chelsea in the Premier League this weekend, with both teams putting their 100 percent records on the line, while Tottenham are desperate to stop the rot.

data.title: Two US sailors removed from Thai resort town after drunken brawl
data.description: PATTAYA — Two sailors from the US aircraft carrier making a port call to Thailand were sent back to the ship after a drunken altercation, Thai police said Friday.

data.title: ‘Talk With The Anutin Cabinet’ to air every Saturday
data.description: The government will launch a new weekly programme, “ Talk With The Anutin Cabinet ”, on Saturday, giving ministers a platform to explain their policies, work and plans directly to the public.

data.title: People aged 65 and over surpass young children in historic global shift
data.description: A US Census Bureau report says the global share of older people will almost double by 2060, increasing pressure on healthcare, public finances and family care.

data.title: Two trapped tunnel workers rescued in Nepal 'miracle'
data.description: KATHMANDU (NEPAL) - Two hydropower workers were pulled alive from a tunnel buried by debris in Nepal on Friday, a rare ray of hope on the tenth day of rescue efforts after catastrophic Himalayan flooding.

data.title: Dense positioning of new streetlights spark questions over 9.9m project
data.description: NAKHON PHANOM — A 9.9-million-baht solar streetlight project in Mukdahan has come under scrutiny on social media over concerns that the lights may have been installed too close together. The local mayor defended the project as necessary and beneficial to the community.

data.title: Former rescue volunteer allegedly rams motorcycle carrying ex-girlfriend, killing two
data.description: Two people were killed after a pickup truck allegedly pursued and deliberately rammed a motorcycle carrying a woman and her new partner in Bangkok early on Thursday, police said.

data.title: 40 Thai officials to study Chinese in Beijing
data.description: Forty Thai government officials will spend a year in Beijing studying Mandarin and experiencing Chinese society and culture under aprogrammeaimed at strengthening people-to-people ties between Thailand and China.

data.title: ONE Championship: Stamp Fairtex vs Selina Flores official for Fight Night 47 main event
data.description: Stamp Fairtex and Selina Flores made their ONE Fight Night 47 main event official on Thursday evening after both passed hydration and made weight in Bangkok.

data.title: ONE Championship: Ferrari Fairtex vs Akif Guluzada main event scrapped after 3.6lb weight miss
data.description: Ferrari Fairtex’s scheduled ONE Championship kickboxing debut against Akif Guluzada has been scrapped from Friday night’s The Inner Circle 29 after the Azerbaijani missed the bantamweight limit by 3.6lb.
